scripts.test: pnpm build && pnpm -r --if-present test && pnpm scripts:test
scripts.clients:render: pnpm build && node packages/client-config/dist/cli.js clients render
scripts.test:catalog: pnpm --dir packages/gateway-core exec vitest run test/catalog.test.ts test/reconcile.test.ts test/publication.test.ts test/publication-candidate.test.ts
scripts.test:protocol: pnpm --dir packages/bridge-protocol exec vitest run test/protocol.test.ts && pnpm --dir packages/bridge-loopback exec vitest run test/server.test.ts && pnpm --dir packages/mcp-server exec vitest run test/protocol.integration.test.ts test/gateway.integration.test.ts test/meridian-runtime.test.ts test/sandbox-profile.integration.test.ts
scripts.test:operations: pnpm --dir packages/operation-journal test && pnpm --dir packages/mcp-server exec vitest run test/operations.integration.test.ts test/legacy-read-routing.integration.test.ts
scripts.test:batches: pnpm --dir packages/batch-engine exec vitest run test/batch.test.ts test/recovery.test.ts test/settlement.test.ts test/scale.test.ts && pnpm --dir packages/mcp-server exec vitest run test/batch.integration.test.ts test/batch-window-scheduler.test.ts
scripts.test:restart: pnpm --dir packages/operation-journal exec vitest run test/journal.test.ts test/effect-broker.test.ts && pnpm --dir packages/batch-engine exec vitest run test/recovery.test.ts && pnpm --dir packages/mcp-server exec vitest run test/meridian-runtime.test.ts
scripts.test:privacy: pnpm --dir packages/gateway-core exec vitest run test/privacy.test.ts test/result.test.ts test/publication.test.ts && pnpm --dir packages/operation-journal exec vitest run test/journal.test.ts
scripts.test:package: pnpm --dir packages/gateway-core exec vitest run test/source-rights.test.ts && pnpm --dir packages/mcp-server exec vitest run test/public-profile-config.test.ts test/public-profile.integration.test.ts && node --test scripts/test/release-gates.test.mjs
